title: 2x Plug Plants Broad Bean De Monica Tall Hardy High Yield Variety
description:
Broad Bean ‘De Monica’ is a larger cultivar that can be sown in autumn for harvest the following spring and summer, or sown in spring for a summer crop. Plants reach around 1.2m in height and need full sun and regular watering when pods are setting for a reliable yield.



Height: approx. 1.2m



Sowing: Autumn for spring/summer harvest, or spring for summer harvest



Position: Full sun, sheltered site preferred



Soil: Moist but well-drained, suitable for acid, alkaline, or neutral soils



Hardiness: H4 – hardy through most of the UK
